description.value:
Prerequisites: Red Mage 6

The red mage can expend 1 point from his arcane pool as an immediate action after hitting a target with a weapon attack, allowing him to anticipate his opponent's defenses. The target is denied its Dexterity bonus against the red mage's attacks until the end of the red mage's next turn.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - Red Mage (Ruby Arcana)
